name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited engages in the design and construction of war ships in India. The company offers frigates, anti-submarine warfare corvette, missile corvette, landing ship tank, landing craft utility, survey vessel, fleet replenishment tanker, fast patrol vessel, offshore patrol vessel, inshore patrol vessel, fast attack craft, anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft, electric ferries, ocean going passenger and cargo ferry vessel, hovercraft, and fast interceptor boat products to the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, and other government.
